name: Lyssna
description_en:
Lyssna brings usability tests, surveys, interviews and participant recruitment into one research workspace.

A team can investigate Figma navigation and combine behavioral tasks with follow-up questions, but study allowances, self-recruited responses and paid panel recruitment remain different cost and capacity limits.
description_zh:
Lyssna 将可用性测试、问卷、访谈和参与者招募结合在一个研究工作区。

团队可研究 Figma 导航并结合行为任务和追问，但研究额度、自招募回答数和付费面板招募仍是不同的成本及容量限制。

core_features.name_zh: 基于任务的 Figma 原型研究
core_features.explanation_en: The prototype page documents direct Figma connection, task prompts, completion/time/misclick analysis and shareable results.
core_features.explanation_zh: 原型页记录直接连接 Figma、任务提示、完成率/耗时/误点击分析及结果分享。

core_features.name_en: Multiple methods in a research study
core_features.explanation_en: The platform includes first-click, five-second, preference, card/tree, surveys and interviews; richer tools and logic depend on the plan.
core_features.explanation_zh: 平台包括首次点击、五秒、偏好、卡片/树、问卷和访谈；高级工具及逻辑取决于套餐。

core_features.explanation_en: Panel responses are separately priced on all plans, while self-recruited response capacity differs between Free and Growth.
core_features.explanation_zh: 所有套餐的面板回答均另计费；Free 和 Growth 的自招募回答容量不同。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Free three seats/15 self-recruited responses. Observed annual Growth USD 166 monthly equivalent, five seats and 60 in-depth studies available upfront. Monthly rate/invoice total unconfirmed. Panel recruitment is paid separately on all plans.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Ask a usability question that the prototype can answer
sections.title_zh: 提出原型能够回答的可用性问题
sections.en:
The prototype-testing page describes linking a Figma prototype without exporting screenshots, assigning tasks and adding rating/open-ended follow-up questions. Results include completion rates, time on task and misclick analysis, with reports that can be shared with stakeholders. The wider platform offers first-click, five-second, preference, card sorting, tree testing, surveys and interviews.

For a hypothetical account-settings redesign, ask participants to locate a specific setting without naming its navigation label. Compare the attempted path and task outcome, then ask what they expected. Keep prototype version and task wording fixed during a round, or document changes. Completion metrics describe behavior inside the configured prototype; they do not prove that a live product’s backend, accessibility or real-world conversion will work. No study was created or run in this research.
sections.zh:
原型测试页描述无需导出截图即可连接 Figma 原型，分配任务并加入评分/开放式追问。结果包括完成率、任务耗时和误点击分析，并可向相关人员分享报告。更广的平台还提供首次点击、五秒、偏好、卡片分类、树测试、问卷和访谈。

以账户设置改版为假设，可要求参与者寻找某个设置，但不直接告诉其导航标签。比较尝试路径及任务结果，再询问预期。每轮应固定原型版本和任务措辞，或记录更改。完成指标描述配置原型中的行为，不证明线上产品后端、可访问性或实际转化可用。本研究没有创建或运行研究。

sections.title_en: Unlimited quick studies still have response and depth limits
sections.title_zh: 快速研究无限仍有回答与深度额度限制
sections.en:
The current Free card lists three seats, unlimited quick studies and 15 self-recruited test/survey responses. Growth lists five seats, unlimited quick studies, five in-depth studies per month and unlimited self-recruited test/survey responses. The annual comparison lists 60 in-depth studies, and the expanded FAQ says annual subscribers can access the annual study allowance upfront. Exact qualification of a study as quick or in-depth was not defined in the read material and should be checked against the proposed study.

The observed annual pricing view displayed USD 166 per month for Growth. Monthly and annual purchase options exist; the actual monthly-billed price and final annual invoice were not captured. Enterprise is custom with unlimited seats and tailored study limits. Growth adds conditional logic, randomization, CSV exports, think-aloud recordings, live-website/mobile testing and MCP access as listed. The mobile page is labeled beta and Enterprise multi-branding is coming soon, so these labels should remain visible in procurement expectations.
sections.zh:
当前 Free 卡片列出三个席位、无限快速研究和 15 个自招募测试/问卷回答。Growth 列出五个席位、无限快速研究、每月五个深度研究和无限自招募测试/问卷回答。年付比较表列出 60 个深度研究，展开 FAQ 说年付用户可提前使用年度额度。已读材料没有定义什么配置属于快速或深度研究，需按拟开展的研究核对。

观察到的年付价格状态显示 Growth 折合每月 USD166。平台提供月付及年付，实际月付价和最终年度发票未捕获。Enterprise 定制，提供无限席位和定制研究额度。Growth 列出条件逻辑、随机化、CSV 导出、出声思考录像、线上网站/移动测试及 MCP 访问。移动页标为 Beta，Enterprise 多品牌功能标为即将推出，采购预期应保留这些状态。

sections.title_en: Recruitment is an additional research budget
sections.title_zh: 招募属于额外研究预算
sections.en:
Lyssna says collecting responses from its participant panel is separately priced on every plan. A free platform account can still access the panel, but free access is not free participant labor. The product describes demographic filters, screening and consumer/professional recruitment. Advertised panel size, country coverage and fulfillment speed are provider claims and were not independently validated.

For an existing-customer workflow, self-recruitment may provide more relevant context than a broad panel; for a new market, filters and screeners should match the actual eligibility question. Keep incentive cost, incidence rate, screening exclusions and replacement conditions in the study budget. This draft does not quote a universal per-participant rate because those task-specific inputs were not established. Nor does the number of demographic filters establish representativeness.
sections.zh:
Lyssna 说所有套餐从面板收集回答均另行计费。免费平台账户仍可访问面板，但免费访问不等于参与者劳动免费。产品描述人口特征筛选、筛选题以及消费者/专业人群招募。宣传的面板规模、国家覆盖和完成速度均为厂商说法，未独立验证。

既有客户流程中，自招募可能比宽泛面板提供更相关背景；进入新市场时，筛选条件和问题应匹配实际资格要求。研究预算应包含激励、符合条件比例、筛选排除及替换条件。由于这些任务输入未建立，本稿不报价一个通用每人单价；筛选维度数量也不能证明代表性。

sections.title_zh: 同意责任随招募路径变化
sections.en:
The browser-readable Services Agreement version 2.3, updated May 14,2025, identifies UsabilityHub Pty Ltd trading as Lyssna. It grants conditional platform access for business purposes. Under its GDPR clauses, the business must obtain necessary consents for company-sourced participants and employee data; Lyssna describes itself as controller for its panel participant data. The distinction matters when a team brings its own customers.

Before a recorded or screen-sharing task, explain what will be captured, who can review it and the intended retention in the research process. Review any prototype containing real customer data and the DPA/subprocessor list rather than relying on a homepage compliance badge. The current AI training, exact recording retention and account-specific access settings were not inspected, so this record makes no zero-retention or no-training guarantee.
sections.zh:
浏览器可读的 Services Agreement v2.3 更新于 2025 年 5 月 14 日，确认运营方为以 Lyssna 名义经营的 UsabilityHub Pty Ltd，并授予附条件的业务用途平台访问权。其 GDPR 条款要求企业对自招募参与者和员工数据取得必要同意，Lyssna 则将自身描述为面板参与者数据控制者。团队自带客户时，这一区分很重要。

在录像或共享屏幕任务前，应说明捕获内容、可查看人员和研究流程中的预期保留时间。原型含真实客户数据时，应检查 DPA、分处理方列表及原型本身，不能只依赖首页合规徽章。当前 AI 训练、具体录像保留和账户访问设置未检查，因此不承诺零保留或不训练。

sections.title_en: Keep source evidence and check renewal terms
sections.title_zh: 保留原始证据并核对续费
sections.en:
The reviewed agreement describes card-linked plans renewing automatically for the same cycle, with generally nonrefundable fees and unused credits subject to applicable law. Manually invoiced renewal follows a different written-confirmation process. Confirm the actual purchase route and export important findings before downgrading; the agreement warns that features, capacity or content can be lost.

Lyssna is a documented candidate for teams moving among short tests, prototype tasks and interviews. AI summaries and follow-ups can reduce synthesis work, but conclusions should remain traceable to actual participant responses. No purchase, screening order, CSV export, Figma connection, mobile capture or MCP execution was tested, and alternatives remain unreviewed.
sections.zh:
已读协议描述，绑定信用卡的套餐按相同周期自动续费，费用及未用点数通常不可退，仍受适用法律约束。人工开票续费采用不同的书面确认流程。应核对实际购买渠道，并在降档前导出重要发现；协议提示可能失去功能、容量或内容。

文档显示 Lyssna 可作为需要在短测试、原型任务和访谈之间切换的团队候选。AI 摘要及追问可能减少整理工作，但结论应能追溯至真实参与者回答。本研究未测试购买、筛选订单、CSV 导出、Figma 连接、移动录制或 MCP 执行，替代关系仍未审查。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.en: Confirm quick/in-depth study definitions, panel cost, actual monthly/annual checkout and recording/AI data conditions for the intended study.
research_gaps.zh: 需按具体研究确认快速/深度定义、面板成本、月付/年付结账及录像/AI 数据条件。

research_gaps.en: No participant recruitment, prototype import, recording, export, paid plan, mobile or MCP test was executed.
research_gaps.zh: 未执行参与者招募、原型导入、录像、导出、付费套餐、移动或 MCP 测试。
